sloka: सभाज्यमानो भूतैस्तु खैचरैः खैचरोत्तमः ।पश्चिमं सागरं वाली ह्याजगाम सरावणः ।। ७.३४.२८ ॥
transliteration: sabhājyamāno bhūtaistu khaicaraiḥ khaicarottamaḥ ।paścimaṁ sāgaraṁ vālī hyājagāma sarāvaṇaḥ ।। 7.34.28 ॥

translations.english: Vali, the best among sky-dwellers, being honored by various celestial beings, indeed reached the western ocean with Ravana.
